title: Backpressure — bounded queue
transcript: 0–9s: Worker A runs while B, C and D fill the bounded queue. A FULL signal travels to the producer.
10–14s: The producer pauses with E waiting outside the full queue; the worker continues.
15.5–19s: Taking B frees a slot. The producer resumes and admits E.
21–26s: C leaves the queue and completes. D then leaves and is still running as the scene fades, with E waiting and three jobs completed. This is continued service, not completion of the whole batch.

changes: Continue with D at 23.8s while E waits, replacing the misleading stopped worker ending.
Apply renderer thread bounds to input/filter stages and add audio headroom.

limitations: Generic finite producer/worker example; five jobs, three waiting slots and one worker.
Ends with work in progress; no delivery, durability, rate or deadline guarantee.
Original model was not recorded; this correction does not establish authorship.
